segments.text: Hello, this is David with the Bozeman Public Library,
segments.zh: 大家好，我是 Bozeman 公共图书馆的 David，

segments.text: this time with an update from the future.
segments.zh: 这次带来的是一条来自未来的更新。

segments.text: It's been a couple months
segments.zh: 距离我们拍摄培训视频

segments.text: since we filmed the training videos,
segments.zh: 已经过去几个月了，

segments.text: and there are a couple of updates
segments.zh: 我们的操作规程

segments.text: that we've made to our procedures here.
segments.zh: 有几处更新。

segments.text: The first update is that we will be running the filter
segments.zh: 第一处更新是，激光切割机的过滤器

segments.text: for the laser at four blue dots instead of three.
segments.zh: 要以四个蓝点而不是三个蓝点运行。

segments.text: We are gonna be running this at the higher speed,
segments.zh: 我们会以更高的转速运行它，

segments.text: and the signage on the filter has been updated,
segments.zh: 过滤器上的标识也已经更新，

segments.text: so you'll want to make sure
segments.zh: 所以你们要确认

segments.text: that you see four little blue dots, not three,
segments.zh: 看到的是四个小蓝点，而不是

segments.text: like we talked about in the previous video.
segments.zh: 我们在上一个视频里讲的三个。

segments.text: The second update is regarding material requirements.
segments.zh: 第二处更新是关于材料要求的。

segments.text: For acrylic, we now require that it specifies cast.
segments.zh: 对于亚克力，我们现在要求注明是浇铸型的。

segments.text: There are two types of acrylic you can go out and buy,
segments.zh: 你们能买到的亚克力有两种：

segments.text: extruded and cast.
segments.zh: 挤出型和浇铸型。

segments.text: We found extruded acrylic doesn't work particularly well
segments.zh: 我们发现挤出型亚克力在我们这里效果不太好，

segments.text: in our space due to the smell it produces,
segments.zh: 因为它会产生气味，

segments.text: so we are going to be requiring
segments.zh: 所以我们今后会要求

segments.text: that all acrylic moving forwards specifies cast.
segments.zh: 所有亚克力都注明是浇铸型。

segments.text: You can sometimes find that on the item label.
segments.zh: 有时可以在商品标签上找到这一信息。

segments.text: If you're buying online, a lot of times
segments.zh: 如果你在网上购买，很多时候

segments.text: that's either in the item description,
segments.zh: 它会写在商品描述里，

segments.text: or sometimes if you're on a retailer like Amazon,
segments.zh: 或者如果你在亚马逊这类零售平台上购买，

segments.text: it may be in the item title.
segments.zh: 有时会写在商品标题里。

segments.text: But in some cases, you may also have to dig
segments.zh: 但有些情况下，你可能还得仔细查看

segments.text: into the item specifications.
segments.zh: 商品规格。

segments.text: But somewhere in the process,
segments.zh: 但在这个过程中的某个地方，

segments.text: it should either say cast or casted acrylic,
segments.zh: 应该写有“浇铸”或“浇铸亚克力”，

segments.text: and we do need to see that when you check in
segments.zh: 你来登记使用材料时，

segments.text: to use your material.
segments.zh: 我们需要看到这一点。

segments.text: There are a couple of retailers that only sell casts,
segments.zh: 有几家零售商只卖浇铸型的，

segments.text: so in some cases, you may find
segments.zh: 所以有些情况下，你可能会发现

segments.text: that the individual item doesn't specify cast,
segments.zh: 单个商品没有注明是浇铸型，

segments.text: but you can find somewhere on their website
segments.zh: 但你可以在他们网站上的某处找到

segments.text: that's like all materials sold by a star cast acrylic
segments.zh: 类似“本店所售材料均为浇铸亚克力”

segments.text: or something to that effect,
segments.zh: 这样的说明，

segments.text: we can work with that as well.
segments.zh: 这种情况我们也可以接受。

segments.text: If you have any questions, please contact the lab desk
segments.zh: 如果有任何问题，请联系实验室服务台，

segments.text: and enjoy using the laser.
segments.zh: 祝你们使用激光切割机愉快。
